item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.35 (53)
- New: Look Up's word library remembers the words you look up with ⌃⌘D once a definition has stayed open a second, and the next time you look one up, a line beside it says when you first learned it, how often you have seen it and what it means. It is off until you turn it on in Look Up's settings, and it is kept in your Xin account, so your other Macs share it. - New: the Word Library window lists your words with search and sorting, and lets you remove words, import a word list (CSV or tab-separated files, Anki and Quizlet exports, Youdao's wordbook, or one word per line) with a preview of its columns, undo an import, reclaim space and delete the library. - Look Up's diagnostic log no longer records the word you looked up, the text around it or captured images. - Dictation: words go into Chrome's installed web apps, such as YouTube, as they do in Chrome. - The ⌃⌘Z dimming toggle keeps a monitor's own brightness and contrast to restore until the monitor confirms them, so it no longer leaves an external display black after waking. - The Word Library and Redundancy & Clutter's image preview open centred on your display instead of at its bottom-left corner.
